name: freecad-agentlink
description: Drive FreeCAD from Claude: parts, printability, strength, drawings, scans, textures and lessons, headless or live in the FreeCAD window.
long_description: Finds FreeCAD on this Mac and installs Agent Link for FreeCAD and its add-ons into FreeCAD's Mod folder: ScanRuler for FreeCAD (scan measuring, ported from ScanRuler by Stefan Hermann, CNC Kitchen), Workshop (standard parts, making, electronics, drawings, SafetyNet), Texturizer (BumpMesh's surface textures, also by Stefan Hermann, CNC Kitchen), Tutor (lessons in your own window) and Agent Link for OrcaSlicer. Works headless with no FreeCAD window open. To watch the work, open FreeCAD, pick the Agent Link workbench and press Start Link, then start a new chat: the extension relays to the window. Agent Link, Workshop, Tutor and the OrcaSlicer add-on are LGPL-2.1-or-later (data CC-BY-4.0); ScanRuler for FreeCAD and Texturizer are AGPL-3.0-only (fonts OFL-1.1). Not affiliated with or endorsed by the FreeCAD project, the FPA or CNC Kitchen.
